title: Constructible-source factorization into filtered colimits at the coefficient universe
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $G$ be a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Work with $X:\mathrm{Scheme}_{u}$ and module values in universe $u+1$. Let $A$ be a small filtered category in universe $u+1$, let $D:A\to\mathrm{Mod}(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$ be a diagram, and let $c$ be a colimit cocone for $D$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Every morphism $p:G\to c.\mathrm{pt}$ factors through a leg: there exist $a\in A$ and $q:G\to D(a)$ with $c_a\circ q=p$. The diagram objects need not be constructible.

source.place: Tag 09Z4, lemma-constructible-is-compact, proof of the module case; Tag 095N; Sites Tag 0738(4)

proof.text: Choose the finite affine-free presentation P_1 -> P_0 -> G provided by [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-finite-presentation]. Its cokernel cofork is colimiting, including when either finite indexing set is empty. Each free sheaf P(W) is the sheafification of uliftYoneda(W) followed by the free-module functor.

source.place: Tag 09Z4, lemma-constructible-is-compact, proof of the module case; Tag 095N; Sites Tag 0738(4)

proof.text: For every sheaf H, compose the sheafification adjunction, the free-module adjunction whiskered by the site, and the lifted Yoneda equivalence to identify Hom(P(W),H) with H(W). Naturality of both adjunctions and Yoneda gives e(p followed by f)=f_W(e(p)), so these equivalences form a natural isomorphism of the Hom functor with evaluation followed by the underlying-set functor.

source.place: Tag 09Z4, lemma-constructible-is-compact, proof of the module case; Tag 095N; Sites Tag 0738(4)

proof.text: An affine W is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. The section-colimit comparison is bijective by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-qcqs-sections-filtered-colimit], at indexing universe u+1. The underlying-set functor on modules preserves filtered colimits, so evaluation followed by this functor does also. The preceding natural isomorphism makes every affine-free P(W) finitely presentable in universe u+1.

source.place: Tag 09Z4, lemma-constructible-is-compact, proof of the module case; Tag 095N; Sites Tag 0738(4)

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-colimit-finitely-presentable] first to each finite discrete diagram of affine-free objects, obtaining finite presentability of P_0 and P_1, then to the walking parallel pair of f and zero with colimit G. Thus G is finitely presentable in universe u+1. Mathlib IsFinitelyPresentable.exists_hom_of_isColimit now factors any map G -> c.pt through one leg of the given filtered colimit cocone c.

theorem exists_constructible_hom_of_isColimit
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hG : IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf G)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory A] [IsFiltered A]
    {D : A ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    {c : Cocone D} (hc : IsColimit c) (p : G ⟶ c.pt) :
    ∃ (a : A) (q : G ⟶ D.obj a), q ≫ c.ι.app a = p
